notes: Gem catalog, priced with the Power Level system's SOCKET/GEM rules
(src/engine/balance.ts, docs/power-level-reference.md "Socket / Gem PL
accounting"). Each gem's OWN PL must land EXACTLY on its rarity's band
(BUDGET_TOLERANCE_DECI = 0, same zero tolerance as the card audit — user-
locked 2026-07-19): Common 2 · Rare 4 · Epic 6 · Legendary 8 — checked by
`isGemOnBudget` (see tests/engine/gemAudit.test.ts). Gem PL is uncapped
bonus power stacked on top of a card's authored (tier-budgeted) kit; it is
NEVER folded into the base-card audit.
`GemDef` is display data layered on the engine's structural `Gem` type —
`name`/`text` aren't consumed by the engine, only by content/UI.

migration removed). This NEW id is THE Echo: the one gem in the catalog
whose hit is `statStrike` + `echoHostPower` — proportional to whichever
card it is socketed into (half the host's own flat base + half the
caster's scaling stat), so it never needs a per-skill reskin the way the
old flat "echo" chips did (§6.1, "one per skill" is obsolete).
PRICE (host-blind, `isGemOnBudget`/the shop): actionsPriceDeci charges
an uncapped statStrike 0 (unbounded value, no honest flat rate) + the
extraHitPremium (30, one appended hit) + the echoRepeatDeci stand-in
(floor(100/2) = 50) = 80 deci = Legendary EXACTLY — the only shareOf
that lands on a band (see PRICE.echoRepeatDeci in balance.ts).
weightIncreasePct 25 is the shipped default tempo cost (§6.2's one
PL-free tuning dial): the socketed card hits harder AND comes out later.

def.name: Ripple Sliver
def.text: {{Splash}} — this card's {{Burden}} or {{Curse}} also lands on the cards either side of the one it targets.
notes: THE splash gem — the only one (user ruling 2026-08-21, verbatim: "there
should only be 1 gem to give splash why is there 2 splash gem"). Its SOLE
action is `splash`: it grants the SPREADER and nothing else, widening the
host's own card-targeting payload (`burden` or `curse`) from the anchor to
the whole band. It replaces tremor_sliver (burden 4 + splash, Common) and
fracture_sliver (burden 8 + splash, Rare): that two-rung ladder was a
fossil of the retired splash-as-weight-tax model — the ladder laddered the
BURDEN's magnitude, and splash itself has no magnitude to ladder.
PRICE: splash = 20 deci flat (PRICE.splashFlatDeci, the keyword's own
standalone rate — user ruling 2026-08-21: "every gem pl is standalone") =
Common EXACTLY. No other field, so nothing else to price.
ONLY USEFUL ON A CARD-TARGETING HOST, by design: THE SPLASH GATE in
resolveEffectiveSkill (src/engine/cards.ts) drops the spreader on a host
with no `burden`/`curse` to spread (`nothingToSpread`), on a host that
already splashes, and on a multi-target host — and that suppression
subtracts the gem's contribution from the piece's instance PL
(instancePowerLevelDeci), so a spreader that never fires is never paid
for. Socket it into Shockwave Slam-shaped cards' anchor-only siblings —
Dulling Hex is the shipped showcase host.
DELIBERATELY NOT REPLACED: standalone `burden` gems at the retired rungs'
magnitudes (4/8). Whether the bare weight tax deserves its own gem ladder
is an open design question for balance-designer/game-director; this
consolidation only settles the spreader.

def.name: Sanctuary Sliver
def.text: {{Ward}} 1 — prevent the next ailment outright · +5% ARMOR (2 turns).
notes: NEW (balance-designer, 2026-08-18) — gap-analysis item B. `ward` alone
has no single-action band landing (charges * 50 = 50/100/150, none of
20/40/60/80), but a MULTI-ACTION gem is structurally legal (`GEM_ACTION_
PHASE` in cards.ts is exhaustive over every Action kind including ward,
and validateGemContent.ts's actions array has no length cap) — so a
companion action closes the gap instead: ward 1 (50) + buffStat armor
5%x2t (5*2*1 = 10) = 60 deci = Epic exactly. Companion chosen for theme,
not filler: a small lingering resilience buff reads as part of the same
protective ward, not an unrelated bolt-on. Minimal-magnitude clean —
ward's charges floor at 1 (no smaller variant exists) and buffStat's
pct/turns each strictly lower the total if decreased alone.

def.name: Ballast Sliver
def.text: {{Burden}} +8 weight on the card the enemy is about to play (paid once, whenever that card is next played).
notes: THE BURDEN GEM, entry rung — closes the gap the splash consolidation left:
with tremor_sliver/fracture_sliver retired (2026-08-21, one-splash-gem ruling)
the catalog had a gem for the SPREADER and none for the PAYLOAD it spreads.
This is the payload alone: a weight tax on the ANCHOR (the card the victim is
about to play), Math.max'd against any standing tax and spent by that card's
next play.
This ANSWERS the question that consolidation deliberately left open — whether
the bare weight tax deserves its own gem ladder. It does, and it is a ladder on
the MAGNITUDE, which is exactly what splash could never have: burden has a
number, the spreader does not.
PRICE: burden 8 = 20 deci (PRICE.burdenPerWeightNum/Den, 5/2) = Common EXACTLY.
MINIMAL for its band: burden 7 prices at floor(7*5/2) = 17, no band.
NOT A TWIN of quickening_sliver (slow 8, also Common 20): burden and slow share
one rate for one currency, so the numbers coincide — the EFFECTS do not. A slow
taxes the UNIT and is dropped at end of turn whether or not it was ever paid; a
burden taxes a CARD and rides that piece until it is played. Same price, a
deferred-but-certain tax against an immediate-but-perishable one.
ITS BEST HOST IS A SPREADER CARD: the spreader is CAST-SCOPED
(castSpreadsBand, combat/interpreter.ts), so on shockwave_slam / arc_cascade /
line_breaker / sapping_arc the HOST's own splash widens THIS GEM's burden across
the band — and it needs no gate of its own to do it.

def.name: Millstone Sliver
def.text: {{Burden}} +16 weight on the card the enemy is about to play (paid once, whenever that card is next played).
notes: Upper rung of the burden ladder — see ballast_sliver for the keyword, the
slow-vs-burden distinction and the spreader-host note.
PRICE: burden 16 = 40 deci = Rare EXACTLY. Minimal for its band (burden 15
prices at floor(15*5/2) = 37, no band). Double the Common rung — the same
doubling step the slow gems use (8 / 16 / 32).
Epic and Legendary rungs would land exactly at burden 24 (60) and burden 32
(80), deliberately NOT shipped: +24 or +32 is most of a turn's banking on the
anchor, and on a spreader host it is that across the whole band. Those rungs
are balance-designer's to open once the lane has play data.

def.name: Blunting Sliver
def.text: {{Curse}} the card the enemy is about to play deals 4 less damage for 2 turns.
notes: THE CURSE GEM — the other half of the card-targeting gap the splash
consolidation left (ballast_sliver is the first). `curse` is burden's sibling on
the DAMAGE axis: a burden makes the anchor come out LATER, a curse makes it come
out SOFTER. Same anchor geometry and the same non-stacking rule (stronger amount
AND later expiry, maxed independently), but it ends on a CLOCK instead of being
spent by a play.
PRICE: curse 4 for 2 turns = 20 deci = Common EXACTLY — 4 x 5/2 = 10 for the
first denial (PRICE.cursePerAmountNum/Den) plus 4 x 2 x 5/4 = 10 for the repeats
(PRICE.cursePerAmountTurnNum/Den). MINIMAL for its band: no smaller amount or
shorter window reaches 20 (curse 3/2t = 14, curse 4/1t = 15).
SAME MAGNITUDE AS sapping_arc's curse line, deliberately — that card spends 20
deci on the curse and 20 on the spreader, so this gem is the socketable half of
it. On a spreader host the host's own splash widens this curse to the band,
exactly as it does a burden.

def.name: Festering Sliver
def.text: +8 damage if the target already carries {{Poison}} (checked before the card acts).
notes: THE CONDITIONAL-RIDER FAMILY'S FIRST GEM. Eight rider keywords (exploit,
stackBonus, taxBonus, shieldBurst, wardRelease, desperation, overhealShield,
cleanseConvert) had ZERO gem representation; this opens the family with its
plainest member, `exploit` — flat bonus damage on the host's own hit when the
target already carries a named affliction.
PRICE: exploit 8 = 20 deci = Common EXACTLY (8 x strikeRate / conditionalBonusDen
= 8 x 5/2 at GEM_CANONICAL_PROPERTY). Minimal for its band: exploit 7 = 17.
THE DISCOUNT IS HONEST HERE BY CONSTRUCTION: the gem supplies no poison of its
own, so `selfSynergyPremiumDeci` is 0 and the conditional rate is the right one —
somebody else's poison has to be on the target. A gem cannot forfeit the discount
on its own anyway: it is priced host-blind, and a pairing is the plain sum of the
two standalone prices (user-locked 2026-08-21).
SPLICES `pre` (GEM_ACTION_PHASE, src/engine/cards.ts), so the bonus is armed
BEFORE the host's damage reads it — the same phase comboBonus uses, and the
reason follow_through_echo works. On a host with no damage line it is inert,
which is the shape follow_through_echo already has.
READS POISON, the catalog's widest affliction (venom_sliver, venom_fang_echo and
the whole poison card lane supply it). burn/bleed/expose variants price
identically and are open rungs, not shipped.
